page: OVHcloud c2-30 is a compute-optimized instance provisioned on KVM hypervisors. It features 8 dedicated x86_64 physical cores powered by an Intel Haswell-generation processor running at 3.0 GHz, configured with 1 thread per core. The compute hardware includes 32 KB L1d, 4 MB L2, and 16 MB L3 cache, with AVX, AES, BMI2, and FMA instruction support. Memory capacity is fixed at 30.0 GB, providing 3.75 GB of RAM per vCPU. Local storage includes a 200 GB SSD, while hardware GPU acceleration is absent with zero GPUs installed.

Benchmark results place the c2-30 instance squarely in average performance tiers across multithreaded workloads, balanced by some single-threaded bottlenecks. In stress-ng, multi-core CPU performance reaches 6708.13 (middle 50%), while single-core performance registers 856.08 (bottom 10%). Geekbench scores echo this distribution with 1228.0 in single-core and 6229.0 in multi-core metrics, alongside 11411.0 in Clang software compilation. Read-only cached memory bandwidth hits 682.04 GB/sec, although uncached large block write bandwidth drops to 23.36 GB/sec (bottom 25%).

Application and operational metrics reflect stable mid-tier system efficiency. The PassMark CPU test scores 10085.08, supported by 4935.1 on database operations and 10.12 million operations per second during Redis SET operations. Web serving throughput sustains 7.97 GB/sec. On inference tests using small models (135M), prompt processing achieves 626.44 tokens/sec and text generation delivers 93.35 tokens/sec. However, scaling to a 7B parameter model highlights hardware constraints, dropping token generation down to 7.22 tokens/sec.

The c2-30 serves reliably for compute-focused tasks requiring fully dedicated execution units rather than hyperthreaded threads, such as software compilation pipelines, multi-threaded batch compression, Redis caching, and mid-sized database operations. The main engineering tradeoffs involve the older Haswell microarchitecture without modern AVX-512 extensions and slower single-threaded throughput, alongside a 0 Gbps baseline network rating.
description: OVHcloud c2-30 is a compute-optimized virtual server configured with 8 dedicated x86_64 cores operating at 3.0 GHz on an Intel Haswell architecture. It includes 30.0 GB of system memory, yielding 3.75 GB per core, and bundles 200 GB of local SSD storage without GPU acceleration. Across synthetic benchmarks, the server delivers median multithreaded performance, demonstrated by a Geekbench multi-core score of 6229.0, a PassMark CPU score of 10085.08, and Redis processing throughput of 10.12 million SET operations per second. However, single-core metrics remain lower, reflected by a stress-ng single-core score of 856.08 and slower 7B model token processing. The hardware setup delivers balanced CPU-to-RAM proportions suited for continuous multithreaded workloads, CI/CD code compilation, caching layers, and intermediate database processing.
